title: CheckFocusPunch_ClearVarsBeforeTurnStarts pre-pass: '<mon> is tightening its focus!' before ANY action, no Random()
scenario: Player BRELOOM (Giga Drain/Leech Seed/Focus Punch/Headbutt, Speed 90) vs faster JOLTEON (Sand-Attack x4, Speed 150; MOVE_TARGET_SELECTED, no damage, so Focus Punch is not interrupted). Focus Punch arm: A, DOWN, A (slot 2). Control arm: A, A (Giga Drain, slot 0). Same seed, both scene modes, each run twice fresh with a dense PNG per frame 0..766.

fixShape: Between turn-order fixing and action 1 (factoryBattleScriptFullTurnDecision.ts, after :3197 / before :3199), walk battlers 0..1 in index order and, for each whose chosen move this turn is MOVE_FOCUS_PUNCH and who is not asleep, not Truant-loafing and not noValidMoves, run BattleScript_FocusPunchSetUp as its own end2 script (gBattlerAttacker = that battler) so its two message events and the FOCUS_PUNCH_SETUP playanimation precede action 1. No RNG: the ROM spends 0 Random() in the pre-pass.
